langgraph_topology.knowledge_path: entry_classifier -> strategic_advisor -> planner -> section_worker(parallel) -> merge_sections -> critic -> respond
langgraph_topology.code_path: entry_classifier -> strategic_advisor -> supervisor -> context_curator -> worker -> patch_integrity_gate -> critic -> respond

critic.crag_triggers: state.crag_triggers — CRAG:section_name:confidence flags for corrective web search

rag.evidence: normalized from state.tool_refs; each: {evidence_id, source_type, source_ref, content, trust}

retry.used_evidence_ids: ids from tool_refs cited in blocking_issues

critic_policy_engine.advisory_bypass: When difficulty < critic_skip_below_difficulty: skip critic entirely (routed by graph)
critic_policy_engine.toulmin_eval: Evaluate claims using Toulmin Model: grounds, warrant, qualifier, rebuttal. 3+ uncommitted X-or-Y decisions = BLOCKING.
critic_policy_engine.crag_assessment: Estimate factual grounding confidence per section. Below crag_web_trigger_threshold -> CRAG:section:confidence in residual_risks.
critic_policy_engine.retry_decision: PASS->respond; CRAG triggers->corrective_web; RETRY->supervisor when not approved and should_continue and attempt < max

scoring_model.continuous_scaling: difficulty 0.0-1.0 scales critic strictness: lenient below critic_lenient_below_difficulty, strict above

evidence_gating.when_blocking: Every blocking_issue should cite evidence when available
evidence_gating.when_missing: Override approved to true; add nonblocking note
evidence_gating.needs_more_evidence: CriticOut.need_more_evidence; route to supervisor; emit evidence_needed (query_plan)

retry_controller.increment_attempt: When RETRY for needs_revision (NOT when need_more_evidence)
retry_controller.diversification: revision_strategy from strategy_candidates; append to revision_strategies_tried
retry_controller.same_failure_shortcircuit: failure_id in failure_ids_seen -> skip retry, route to critic->respond
retry_controller.fail_fast: iteration >= max_iterations -> PASS (forced), route to respond

escalation_policy.trigger: Repeated RETRY with same failure_pattern; at max_attempts
escalation_policy.mode_escalation: tiered basic->advanced when iteration>0; no thrashing (do not downgrade)

monotonicity_invariants: retry.attempt only increments on needs_revision RETRY
retry.constraints only add keys; never delete

critic.purpose: Toulmin-based quality evaluation; CRAG assessment; PASS/RETRY/FAIL; intent+domain aware
critic.decision_logic: Toulmin rubric for quality; CRAG confidence for factual grounding; difficulty scales strictness

mcp_tools_available.sandbox_execute: MCP tool for code execution in isolated K8s pod (base/mcp/tools/sandbox_tool.py). Not wired into graph; available for MCP-capable clients.
mcp_tools_available.lsp_analyze: MCP tool for LSP type analysis (base/mcp/tools/lsp_tool.py). Not wired into graph; available for MCP-capable clients.

examples.scenario: Knowledge task, critic approves with CRAG triggers
Code task, patch integrity passes, critic approves

examples.outcome: PASS forced; route to respond with degraded note
